description: Describes, in qualitative terms, how Marian's automatic rate resets compare with a standard fixed-rate mortgage that the borrower refinances, given the borrower's situation. Returns no rates, payments or dollar figures, because Marian has not published its rates or terms. Marian is pre-launch and not lending in any state. For model estimates for hypothetical designs, see the open-source proof-engine model and its README: https://github.com/MarianMortgage/proof-engine#readme.

balance.description: Outstanding or planned loan balance in US dollars, as given by the user.

current_rate.description: Annual interest rate on the user's current or offered mortgage, in percent.

horizon_years.description: How many years the user expects to keep the mortgage before selling or paying it off.

refinance_behavior.description: How the user tends to act when rates fall: never refinances; refinances late; refinances sometimes (typical); or refinances promptly whenever it pays.

name: compare_to_refinancing
title: Compare to refinancing
